subject: Acme pricing estimate & next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Acme pricing estimate & next steps

Hi Patricia —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Primary workload: customer support reranking + chat summarization for purchase flows.
- Expected production volume: ~100–150M tokens/month (spikey during product launches).
- Target budget: ~$40k/month target (flexible within reason).

Ask from us: can you confirm a target monthly token baseline (conservative) and any hard ceiling on spend? That'll determine whether Hosted vs Dedicated makes sense.

Attached: pricing_calculator.csv (simple unit economics) and cost_breakdown.pdf (line-item assumptions). I put two scenarios in the calc (hosted pay-as-you-go vs 12-mo reserved).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm baseline tokens/month and procurement contact (if not already).
2) I’ll send a short invoice estimate and a suggested mutual action plan (PO, timeline).
3) If Dedicated looks right, scope required commit to provide a formal quote.

If it helps, I can run numbers today for a 120M tokens/month baseline and show Hosted vs Dedicated pricing.

Thanks —
Sean

sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Thanks, Sean — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Baseline tokens/month: plan for 120M tokens/month initially (expected to grow to ~200M over 6 months).
- Budget: target is around $40k/month, procurement will consider higher for demonstrable ROI but that’s our working target.
- Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com (I copied separately when needed).
- Decision criteria: unit cost per 1M tokens (we’re targeting $300–$350/1M tokens ideally), reliability, and SLA/uptime.

Can you run the numbers for 120M/month and share an invoice-style estimate we can share with procurement? Also please call out the delta between Hosted PAYG and a 12-month committed Dedicated discount.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme pricing estimate & next steps

Patricia — thanks for the clarity. I ran the 120M/month scenarios and attached an invoice estimate (invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx) with the assumptions. Summary below: 

Short summary (120M tokens/month):
- Hosted (PAYG): list price $325 per 1M tokens -> 120 * $325 = $39,000/month
  - Pros: no commit, faster onboarding, flexible scale.
  - Cons: higher unit price under steady state.

- Dedicated (12-mo commit, reserved): $285 per 1M tokens -> 120 * $285 = $34,200/month
  - Includes: priority capacity, 99.9% SLA, token-level cost reporting, and 1 week of onboarding support included.
  - Note: deeper discounts available for multi-year/greater commits.

Assumptions called out in the XLSX and cost_breakdown.pdf: token accounting approach, avg response length assumptions (3.2k tokens/user-session), model variant used (open-encoder-v2), and expected batching savings. I also added a sensitivity table (±25% volume) so procurement can see total $ change with volume.

Next steps I recommend:
1) If Procurement is comfortable with the dedicated scenario, Marissa (cc'd) can prep a formal quote and contract template.
2) I can follow up with procurement@acme.com to confirm invoicing terms and PO flow.
3) Schedule a short pricing/technical Q&A with our solutions engineer if they want to dig into KV caching and cost controls.

I attached invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx to this email. Let me know if you'd like me to lower the unit price further and I can ask for an underwriting approval for a deeper commit-based discount.

Thanks —
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Patricia Lopez <patricia.lopez@acme.com>

Thanks Sean — this is very helpful. We prefer the Dedicated 12-mo commit scenario assuming SLA and onboarding are included. A few notes: 

- Procurement contact for PO/terms: procurement@acme.com (they will need the invoice estimate + draft SOW).
- Legal will review standard T&Cs; please flag any revenue recognition or support-level clauses that differ from market norms.
- Timeline: hoping to sign before July to align with our Q3 launch.

Please loop in procurement@acme.com and send the formal quote + draft SOW and invoice so they can start the PO.

Regards,
Patricia

Per Patricia's request, attaching the formal quote (invoice_estimate_v2.xlsx), the pricing calculator (pricing_calculator.csv) and a one-page cost breakdown (cost_breakdown.pdf). Key points repeated here:

- Monthly invoice (net of discounts): $34,200/month (at $285 per 1M tokens).
- Included: onboarding support week, token-level reporting, 99.9% SLA.

Requested next steps from Acme procurement:

2) Send any required vendor forms and payment terms preferences (Net30, Net45).
3) If acceptable, return a signed PO referencing deal ID ACME-2026-001; we'll attach draft SOW and contract for legal review.

Marissa and Dev from Redwood are cc'd — Marissa will own the commercial quote and Dev will help with the onboarding technical checklist.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps to speed things up.
